title: Athens
description: A major city in Greece and the historical center of ancient Greek civilization.

title: Corinth
description: An ancient Greek city on the isthmus connecting the Peloponnese with mainland Greece.

title: Delphi
description: A sanctuary of Apollo and seat of the oracle in central Greece.

title: Piraeus
description: The main port of Athens, with several harbors on the Saronic Gulf.

title: Sparta
description: A powerful city-state in Laconia in the southern Peloponnese.

title: Olympia
description: A sanctuary of Zeus in Elis, site of the ancient Olympic Games.
